fullContentHtml:
Rajasthan RIICO Various Post Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan State Industrial Development and Investment Corporation (RIICO) has released the Admit card for the RIICO Various Post Examination. The online application process for RIICO Various Post Online Form 2026 were accepted from 21 January 2026, to 07 March 2026. The Examination is going to conducted on 08-09 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Rajasthan RIICO Various Post Admit Card 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 January 2026
  • Last Date : 07 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 08-09 July 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 02 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 1000/-
  • OBC / EWS Candidate of Rajasthan : Rs. 750/-
  • SC / ST Candidates of Rajasthan: Rs. 500/
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Rajasthan RIICO Various Post Admit Card 2026?

Rajasthan RIICO Various Post Admit Card 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 07 March 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://riico.rajasthan.gov.in/

How to download admit card?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
